messages:
alex: Heads-up: linkcheck failing on /docs/guides/configuration. The fragment target is showing percent-encoded backticks in the URL (`%60`). Looks like a heading inside a markdown table cell includes inline code and the slugifier is encoding the backticks.

pat: Interesting. Example?

alex: In the table we have a header row like: 
```md
| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `max_batch` | controls max batch size |
```
When rendered the heading anchor becomes `option-%60max_batch%60` and old links pointing to `#option-max_batch` 404.

maria: Ugh. Different slugifiers treat inline code differently: some strip inline code markers, others percent-encode them. That explains the regression after the mkdocs->docusaurus layout change.

docs-bot: build failed — mkdocs-linkcheck found 3 broken fragments (exit code 1).

kevin: Two options: 1) ban inline code in table header cells and have authors use plain text, 2) normalize heading slug generation to strip code ticks and backticks before slugify, then add redirects for the encoded variants. I'd go with 2 for backward compatibility.

pat: Agreed on 2. We should also add a lint rule that warns when table headers contain inline code so authors avoid the pattern in future.

alex: I'll prototype a remark plugin that replaces inline code in headings and table header cells with plain text nodes for slug generation while keeping the rendered code visible. Then we can emit an alias id for the old percent-encoded slug during build to avoid immediate 404s.

maria: Also run a repo grep to find other table-head inline code: `git grep -n "| \`.*\` |" docs | sed -E 's/:.*$//' | sort -u` — I found 9 occurrences across the guides and reference.

docs-bot: CI queued for PR 4810 (normalize table header slugs + lint + redirects).

kevin: Added a small migration script in the PR that updates internal links to the canonical slug where possible and writes redirects for external/backlink safety.

alex: Local linkcheck before patch: 12 broken fragments; after applying fixes and redirects: 0. Added a unit test for `slugifyTableHeader('`max_batch`') -> max-batch`.

docs-bot: build passed on PR 4810 — linkcheck OK :white_check_mark:.

maria: Merged. I've posted a short migration note in docs/migration.md and updated CONTRIBUTING.md with the guidance: "Prefer plain text in table headers; use inline code in the cell body if needed."

pat: Nice. Closing this thread unless anyone sees more anchor oddities.

kevin: Thanks all — good catch, @alex.
